entry.title: Ferrara turns to the past for Christmas confectionery success
entry.summary: Ferrara’s 2026 Christmas confectionery range combines nostalgic favourites with seasonal innovation, as consumer demand for limited-edition festive treats continues to grow. Backed by research showing 73% of shoppers buy seasonal confectionery before December, the collection highlights how brands are balancing tradition, novelty and emotional connections to drive Christmas sales.

entry.title: How clear protein boosted the functional drinks category
entry.summary: Clear protein, which allows manufacturers to produce high-protein drinks that do not have the category's traditional milky, thick texture, drastically expands what the category can do. Protein can now be used in clear drinks such as soft drinks and waters.

entry.title: Product data is critical to consumer trust in AI shopping
entry.summary: Trust in agentic commerce can stem from poor underlying product data, not just skepticism about AI, allowing brands and retailers to rethink how they show up in AI searches and strengthen consumer trust, according to Circana.

entry.title: The cost of conflict: Food supply chains under pressure
entry.summary: Wars around the world, including those in Ukraine, Sudan and Iran, have had a significant impact on food production. Imports and exports of key agricultural products like fertiliser are being restricted, and regionally concentrated ingredients like saffron and acacia gum are coming under fire. How can the food industry protect itself?

entry.title: General Mills restructures into three segments
entry.summary: Food and beverage giant General Mills is restructuring into three business segments at the beginning of 2027. It recently named leadership to oversee those new segments.
